english.title: Print / cause to be printed a prohibited advertisement of a low-welfare animal activity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in the course of a business,

(A)_[printed in England an advertisement that was published in England and was]_
(B)_[caused an advertisement that was published in England to be printed in England, it being]_

a prohibited advertisement in that it had the purpose or effect of promoting the observation of, or participation in, an activity which involved an animal, taking place outside the United Kingdom and was of a description specified by activity regulations made by the Secretary of State, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 2(3) and 3(1) of the Animals (Low-Welfare Activities Abroad) Act 2023.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) It is a defence for a person charged with this offence in relation to the printing or distribution of an advertisement in a relevant part of the United Kingdom to prove that the person did not know, and had no reason to suspect, that the advertisement would be published in that part (section 2(6) of the Animals (Low-Welfare Activities Abroad) Act 2023.
(ii) See section 3(6) of the Act for offences committed by bodies corporate.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, in the course of a business,

(A)_[printed an advertisement]_
(B)_[caused an advertisement to be printed]_

in England that was published in England and was a prohibited advertisement in that it had the purpose or effect of promoting the observation of, or participation in, an activity which involved an animal, took place outside the United Kingdom and was of a description specified by activity regulations made by the Secretary of State, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..).

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None - see section 3(6) of the Animals (Low-Welfare Activities Abroad) Act 2023.
